title: Christmastime Fireworks Dessert Party at Tomorrowland Terrace | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: Minnie's Wonderful Christmastime Fireworks Dessert Party at Tomorrowland Terrace Located in Tomorrowland at Magic Kingdom Park Treat your senses to festive desserts and fireworks views during Mickey’s Very Merry Christmas Party. The 2025 offering has concluded. Check back this summer for updates on the 2026 event. Dining Events Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Valid admission required. A theme park reservation may be required based on admission type. Check back in September 2026 to make a reservation during Mickey’s Very Merry Christmas Party.Sweeten Your Holiday CelebrationSavor some holly-jolly joy at a dazzling dessert party!Visions of sugarplums dancing in your head? Make your decadent dreams come true at Minnie's Wonderful Christmastime Fireworks Dessert Party at Tomorrowland Terrace—which includes:A bountiful buffet of delectable treats at Tomorrowland Terrace RestaurantAwe-inspiring views of Minnie’s Wonderful Christmastime Fireworks from a reserved seating areaThis separately priced experience takes place during Mickey’s Very Merry Christmas Party in Magic Kingdom park.Know Before You GoBe sure to review the following important information about this event. This dessert party is only offered during Mickey’s Very Merry Christmas Party. Advance reservations are highly recommended.A valid admission ticket for Mickey’s Very Merry Christmas Party on the same night is required, and is not included in the price of the dessert party.There is a 24-hour cancellation policy. Full price will be charged/forfeited if the Guest cancels within one day or fails to show up for the reservation. Learn more about the reservation cancellation policyThis experience does not allow for modifications once the reservation is confirmed.In the event of inclement weather, the fireworks may be delayed or cancelled. The dessert party will take place rain or shine, even if the fireworks are cancelled.Credential identification is non-transferrable and will not be replaced if lost or stolen.This offer may not be combined with any other discounts or promotions.Menu items are subject to change.All entertainment and experiences are subject to change without notice.Related ActivitiesMinnie's Wonderful Christmastime Fireworks Dessert Party with Plaza Garden ViewingEnjoy tantalizing treats and spectacular fireworks from a reserved viewing area.Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party DiningEnhance your evening with a wonderful meal at select Magic Kingdom restaurants.Minnie’s Wonderful Christmastime FireworksLook to the sky for a festive fireworks show hosted by the marvelous Minnie Mouse.
